content.title: 主谓一致(2)·分数百分比 / 不定代词 / 就近原则 速查
content.intro: 主谓一致(2)的核心:看清"真正的主语是什么、它在意义上是单数还是复数"。三条主线:① 分数/百分比/most/half/the rest of 看 of 后的名词;② 不定代词大多看作单数;③ either…or 等并列主语和 there be 看"最近"的那个名词。

rows: 分数/百分比 + of + 名词
看 of 后名词:50 per cent of the work is… / 50 per cent of the jobs are…
most / half / part / the rest of + of
看 of 后名词:the rest of the report was… / the rest of the workers were…
each / every / either / neither / one of
单数:Each of the robots is… / Neither of them is…
everyone / everything / someone / nobody / none(正式)
单数:Everyone is… / None of us is…
both / all(+复数) / a number of
复数:Both are… / A number of clients have…
all / none(+不可数) / the number of
单数:All of the data is… / The number of jobs is…
many a / more than one + 单数名词
单数:Many a student has… / More than one expert has…
就近原则:Neither the cars nor the robot is…
与紧跟的第一个名词一致:There is an assistant and apps… / There are apps and one assistant…

specialRules.rule: 分数/百分比的单复数完全取决于 of 后的名词,本身不决定
specialRules.mark: 50% of time is √ / 50% of jobs are √

specialRules.rule: more than one + 单数名词,虽意义为多,仍用单数
specialRules.mark: More than one robot is tested.

specialRules.rule: a number of(许多)→复数;the number of(……的数量)→单数
specialRules.mark: a number of … have / the number of … is

specialRules.rule: either…or / neither…nor / not only…but also + there be 一律就近
specialRules.mark: 与最近的主语保持一致

why: 谓语真正要呼应的是"主语在意义上的数":of 短语里真正的中心词在 of 之后;不定代词 each/every/none 等强调"每一个/没有一个",所以看作单数;并列主语和 there be 则按英语习惯只与离动词最近的名词呼应。
gaokaoPoints: 语法填空/短文改错高频:百分比、分数、none、neither of、there be、either…or 的动词单复数。
易错点:the number of(单) vs a number of(复);more than one(单);all/none + 不可数(单)vs + 复数(复)。

examVsReal.exam: None of us is ready.(考试/正式书面)
examVsReal.note: 考试和正式写作里 none 多用单数;但日常口语中 none of + 复数常用复数,两者都听得到

examVsReal.exam: Neither of the answers is correct.(考试)
examVsReal.note: 考试严格用单数;口语里 neither of + 复数常被说成复数
